## Solution

Since all four roots are negative integers, write $f(x) = (x+p)(x+q)(x+r)(x+s)$ with $p, q, r, s$ positive integers. Then $d = f(0) = pqrs$.

Evaluating at $x = 1$ gives $f(1) = 1 + a + b + c + d = 1 + 2009 = 2010$, so

$$(1+p)(1+q)(1+r)(1+s) = 2010 = 2 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdot 67.$$

Each factor $1+p$ is at least 2. The prime factorization of 2010 has exactly four prime factors, so the only way to write it as a product of four integers each at least 2 is $2, 3, 5, 67$. Hence $\{p, q, r, s\} = \{1, 2, 4, 66\}$.

Check: the roots $-1, -2, -4, -66$ give $f(1) = 2 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdot 67 = 2010$, so $a+b+c+d = 2009$ as required.

Therefore
$$d = 1 \cdot 2 \cdot 4 \cdot 66 = 528.$$

ANSWER: 528
